int4_per_token_head.source: vLLM's INT4 per-token-head page (v1/attention/ops/int4_per_token_head.py: two 4-bit values a byte, RHT pre-rotated, a 4-bit zero-point in the scale): TritonAttentionBackend.customize_spec content = (head_k // 2 + head_v // 2) B + 2 fp32 scales per token and head — 264 B at head size 256 against bfloat16's 1,024, i.e. 264 / 512 B an element (read in myllmbox/qwen38-flash-next-cluster-vllm:v5 on box-a, 2026-10-26).
